role: exploratory challenger (not part of the primary holdout comparison of preregistration.json)
what: blend-v2 with its decision model retrained on the 2014-2026 radar history without era terms (training set 'hist' of experiments/history12); same logit, same Part B library, same code (runtime 2026-10-31-wave2-r5)
why: best candidate of wave 3: blend(hist) - blend(recent) Brier(1,6,24,48) -0.0011 [-0.0019, -0.0004] on the long test (lag 2), a secondary diagnostic that was not pre-registered, so it is judged only on live forecasts issued after this file was written

training.labels: fra.labels history labels, complete days, bridge='night', gap rule 'confirmed'
training.cutoff: outcome and look-ahead published before 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC

evaluation.sample: official issue hours after written_utc where both blend-hist12 and blend-v2 issued (live scoring, fra.scoring)
evaluation.primary: Brier(1,6,24,48) of blend-hist12 minus blend-v2, paired day-block bootstrap (3-day blocks, as the holdout scoring)
evaluation.first_look: 2026-12-03 (4 weeks); if the CI includes 0, extend to 8 weeks (2026-12-31) and decide then
evaluation.decision: candidate for champion only if the primary CI is entirely below 0 and no lead is significantly less accurate; any switch happens after the main holdout verdict, never during it

frozen: no retraining or change of this variant until the decision
